entries.3116b72a1f8fd113: The company has set out a group corporate philosophy of 'Making use of nature's blessings, based on biotechnology, we provide people with the joy of food and healthy living,' and states that it runs its business on biotechnology with fermentation technology at its core. Under its long-term vision 'NEXT100,' the company has set strengthening the competitiveness of core businesses, taking on new domains and promoting ESG management as three key issues, and it is advancing the 'Medium-Term Management Plan 2028,' which covers the five years from 2024 to 2028. For the third year of the plan, the fiscal year ending December 2026, the company states that it will work on strengthening its presence as a comprehensive shochu maker and on expanding sales channels and scale for alcoholic beverage exports.
entries.4a3e9cea232f4f69: A holding company that, based on fermentation technology, operates liquor businesses such as shochu, enzyme and diagnostic reagent businesses, and a real estate business.
entries.51fe72b654081465: A feature of the company is that since it began producing alcohol in 1900, the first alcohol manufacturing in the private sector, it has operated both alcoholic beverages and enzyme pharmaceuticals businesses with fermentation technology at their core. In alcoholic beverages, it manufactures a wide range of products in its own plants, from shochu to sake, Western spirits and raw-material alcohol, and in enzyme pharmaceuticals it applies the same fermentation technology to diagnostic reagents and fermentation contract services.
entries.52c4e096b7eddd2d: Alcoholic beverages are sold to wholesale and retail businesses and restaurants, and alcohol and enzymes are sold to food and beverage manufacturers. Real estate is provided to purchasers and lessees.
